chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Jerome Pasquall and Charlie Cooke's band at White City
summary: Danny and Milt recall Pasquall's work with Fletcher, King Oliver and Charlie Cooke's high-class band at Chicago's White City.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: There was a good saxophone player around New York that I happened to play with years ago named Jerome Pasquall. Did you ever hear him?
Jerome Pasquall was one of the masters. He had been with Fletcher, he had been with King Oliver, he had been with that big...that great...Cooke's band... Charlie Cooke.
That famous band he had at that White...
White City. I got a picture of that.
Yeah. Who's that trumpet player you called? A little trumpet player...
Yeah. Think he was on there?
That was a high-class band. They played at the Jeffrey Tavern out there, too.
